tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every section. Tailwind: bg-[#0b0d0e] or theme color `bg`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Bento tiles, project cards, timeline cards, the contact form panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover state of a tile or row; the browser-frame toolbar; the mobile menu sheet.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around tiles and cards, section dividers. Decorative only (1.1:1) — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Text-input and textarea borders, the outline of secondary buttons. 3.9:1 on bg, 3.5:1 on surface — meets the 3:1 control-border rule.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on bg, surface and surface-raised (12.6 / 11.4 / 10.5:1).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: H1, H2, project names, role titles; on any surface (≥14.8:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Dates, issuers, mono labels, captions, placeholder text; on bg, surface, surface-raised (6.4 / 5.7 / 5.3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE only accent: links, primary button fill, live-status dots, focus ring, the '01' index numerals. As text it reads 10:1 on surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button) — 11.2:1. Never white on green.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Live badge and the 'Open to work' pill; accent text on it is 9.3:1.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Demo badge and Tag chips; text on it 9.4:1, muted on it 4.8:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form validation messages and the invalid-input border ONLY — a state colour, not a second accent. 9.3:1 on surface; always paired with a written message.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Hi, I'm Amar. I build web apps people use every day.
styles.usage: The one H1 in the hero intro tile. 36px / 40px on mobile.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings (Work, Experience, Certifications, About, Contact). 28px on mobile.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Project names in ProjectRow; 32px for the featured project.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Lets 40 staff swap shifts without a WhatsApp group.
styles.usage: Default paragraph text, bullet points, form text.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia · open to hybrid/remote
styles.usage: Tile captions, meta lines, helper and error text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Index numerals, tile eyebrows, uppercase micro-labels. Never for sentences.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The big number in the stat tile only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Dot-to-label gap in StatusBadge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; icon-to-text in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between bento tiles on mobile; label-to-input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between bento tiles on desktop; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tile and card padding; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between heading and section content; between project rows on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between project rows on desktop; between timeline items.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of each section on desktop (64px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, browser-frame screenshots.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bento tiles, project cards, contact panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the Open-to-work pill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px bg gap, then a solid 2px accent ring (10:1 on surface). Applied with :focus-visible.

tokens.name: phone-lift
tokens.usage: Only under the phone frame that overlaps a browser frame in the featured project.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of every section's content column.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky navbar height; also the scroll-margin-top of section anchors.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: Below this the bento grid, project rows and contact split collapse to one column (Tailwind `md:` = 768px is fine).
